Following the ICE shooting of a man in Texas, I asked @RepSylviaGarcia if people should believe DHS vow to investigate:

“No. You know, that's like the fox guarding the henhouse…and when you look at the Renee Goode case, it's been over six months. We've not had a report. There's been no accountability…This is Texas. We don't put up with horseshit.”

Trump’s threat to Greenland is what led much of Europe to conclude last fall the alliance with the U.S. is forever changed. And clearly the president hasn’t given up:

“Greenland doesn’t help Denmark, Denmark doesn’t spend money to really help Greenland, but it’s an important part for the United States, and it’s surrounded by China ships and Russian ships, and that’s not going to happen,” Trump said. Greenland “should be controlled by the United States, not by Denmark.”
